description: Steile Strecken im Radverkehrsnetz Wuppertal is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.wuppertal.de. The dataset includes the in 2 inclines (notable: 3% - 7%, heavy: greater than 7%) categorised steep sections of the Wuppertal cycling network with a length of at least 500 m. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Steep routes in the Wuppertal cycling network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Zeichen 241, Geh- und Radweg, Radwanderweg, Straßenverkehrsordnung, Radverkehr, Radwegenetz. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2016-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
